S.FORM: == kakiliman == Ciw-cay-kow singanganay aazihan, ngangan Ciw-cay-kow, tini iCong-kow Se-cwan a kuwan amis u A-pa-cang-cu-Cyang-cu misakakuay mikuwan tu cow Ciw-cay-kow a kuwan "yen-Nan-pin a kuwan". Miawas tu tung-cin 103°46'~104°4', pey-wi32°54'~33°19'. zayhan sakahini izaw ku su-cen, he-yey, ce-ca-wa,pan-sin, hey-kow, pan-ya-cu, ku-wa, pung-pu, cyen-pan siwa ku Cang-cu a singangan ku say nu niyazu'. Ciw-cay-kow likid nu nanum makaza i Pay-he, Pay-suy-cyang, Cya-lin-cyang, sazikuzay malikid tayza i Cang-cyang. 1992 a mihcaan mala nu kitakit tahakay niliwanan a zaysang. Ciw-cay-kow tini i Cin-cang-kaw-yen nuwalian timulanay Nay-al-na-sanhung-pey-lu, angangan u Min-san buyu'an masacapa maliwasakay i Ze-ce-kow, Ce-ca-wa-kuw, Su-cen-kow, tulu kasa diheb a cilis, talak i 2000 mi katukuh 3106 mi, tungu nu cuedetay nu kitakit nu Ke-s-te-a hekal. . pulung nu hekay pakala tu 620km², pakala tu 52% pesen ku hekal matahpu nu kilakilangan, zuma simuluay atu cacanan nu micidekay a lutuk balu, katuud ku nu byu'ay a aadupan tayni mihibang, mahizaay u tumay, kalawlaway banuh a ungay, salengacay bilbil a ngabul. i kasienawan Ciw-cay-kow hamin nu bayu banaw taku malakuli tu, uyza canacanan a kuliit zayhan sasaay nu banaw tahkal ku nu buhangay nemnem, nanum nu banaw i kasienawan mahiza tu i 6 tu. Ciw-cay-kow pabaw nu pay-suy a cilis u saciwa' a cilis nu pay-he, siwa ku Cang-cu a niyazu' a singangan. 在冬季, . labu nu Ciw-cay-kow palasepaten ku tabakiay aazihan, Su-cen aadihan, Ze-ce aazihan, Cng bayu aazihan Paw-cin atepad aazihan, u tingalaway a bayu, matatungduhay a cascas, kilakilangan, sulda a buyu' Cnga-cin "u-cye" a singnangan, mapanganga tu "mung-syen-cin" atu "kitakit akamu nu adiwawa". ,被譽為"夢仙境" aazihan a piliwkuan 旅遊景區 miliwku mikacaw tu liwlung kapah ku demiad, caay ka cuedet ku bali, panihiw tu lalud, salungan tu sepat a puu'an, nu kitakitay a kanamuhan nu miliwkuay tayza. Ciw-cay-kow sa u tawyaay bangcal a hekal nu aazihan angangan mababenis i su-cen-cu-kow atu ce-ca-cay, ze-ce tusa ku cipa' nu kow. angangan a kacidek nu tahakay a hekal u buyu'ay a taku atu cascas, masaupu ku taku, cascas, liken nu sauwac, sauwac, suleda a buyu', kilakilangan atu Cangcu malacacay ku balucu' Ciw-cay-kow kasingangan nu hekal aazihan i 1992 a mihcaan mala u kitakitay nu tahakay a niliwanan a zaysang, 1997 a mihcaan u nu kitakit a tademaw atu mauzipay saliyuk a pidiputan, 2000 a mihcaan tu kamu u saayaway nu Cong-kow kanatal 4A ci piazihan nu miliwkuan, 2001 a mihca 2 a bulad maala tu ku "ladaway a hekal 21" cpawacay, 2007 a mihcaan pakal mala ku 5 ci a kanatal piazihan nu miliwkuan, 2021 a mihcaan 9 a bulad, Ciw-cay-kow aazihan a lab uku balubaluan katukuh sumamaday a kilakilangan a tumaynani' bayuay a zazan muculil tu ku kazizeng. 2017 a mihcaan maninel ku Ciw-cay-kow 2017年九寨溝地震 2017 a mihca 8 a bulad 8 a demiad a labii i piazihan tabaki ku ninel, mahamin tu mapelad. zikuz nu ninel labu nu aazihan angangan sauwac a nanum nu Cyang caay tu katabaki. nika macebeday a kilakilanngan "nanum nu bayu" mulaliw tu amin. 9 a demiad macebeday a kilakilangan a sibali tu, nayi' ku katalaw amapeci'. naizaway tu ku Yen-say taku nanikinsaan nayi' ku katalaw amapeci, baluhay a Yen-say banaw nayi' muculal. hamin nu banaw cayay ka lecad ku nikapeci', yadah ku mapelad nu byu'. Zuw-ze-lang cascas pihaceng ku nikapelad, mala u pinaay tu ku likid nu nanum atu lanu'. "Swang-lung-hay" atu "Lu-wi-hay" mahamin tu malikid, "Law-hu-hay" atu "Lu-wi-hay" pihaceng ku kapeci' a lilis nu apilis, "Si-niw-hay" nuayawanay kilangay langat a zazan atu "aazihan tu nipahabayan a kilang" uyza silangatay ku liwliw a zazan mapeci' tu. namaninel, 2017 a mihca 8 a bulad 9 a demiad malingatu, Ciw-cay-kow aazihan pacena' maedeb, pasatezepe miawza tu midangay a labang. Se-cwan kuwan A-pa-cang-cu cyang-cu ce-ce-cow wiy-su-ci ci Liw-cuw-min hinisa Ciw-cay-kow aaziihan apasasizumaen, pasagatuen haymaw a pahulak, amisumad tu acanu a paya nu panan. Ciw-cay-kow zikuz nu ninel I 2018 a nihca 3 a bulad 8 a demiad pacema' miwawah, demidemiad mitiyang tu micumuday a tademaw cacay a demiad 2000 ku tademaw, miawza tu masakaputay a labang dada', pacena' caay piawza tu sakaku sanay midang a labang, zikuz muliyaw aca maedeb. laed tu pinaay tu a mihcaan aninelan, duduc Ciw-cay-kow nu miliwkuay a sakapu bu-cung-cin-li ci Lyaw-cin a pisiwkay "zuma aadihan paliayaw tu 2019 a mihcaan nu kalimulakay nu kanatal a lisin pahekal tu hekalay". 2019 a mihcaan 9 a bulad 24 a demiad, Se-cwan kuwan misulul ku situngusa tu cenbu, Ciw-cay-kow aazihan pasazumaen ku zuma i 9 a bulad 27 a demiad demiad nu miliwkuay nu kitakit panukas pahelak. 2019 a mihcaan 9 a bulad 27 a demiad, Ciw-cay-kow aazihan muliyaw pahelak tu aazihan, mitiyang tu kakitizaan, mitiyang tu ngatu "paydemiad 8 : 30 katukuh 17 : 00" pahekal, cacay a demiad 5000 ku pitiyang tu katuud a labang, mikawaw i wangle micakay tu paya tucek pahelak tu masakaputay, katukuh 11 a bulad 28 a demiad malingatu mipahelak tu sakakuay nu miida a labang, pahelak tu aazihan a kitizaan cacay a demiad tu piawza tu labang sakatuuday a pitiyang makay 8000 ku tademaw pacakat kkatukuh 2 emang tu tademaw. imahini Ciw-cay-kow paya nu panan aazihan, paya nu kazizeng hami i wangle pangangan mipaliayaw micakay, caay tu patizeng tu picakayan a sasingalan. 2021 a mihca 9 a bulad 28 a demiad, Ciw-cay-kow aazihan hamin nu kakitizaan panukas a pahelakan, cacay a demiaad miawza tu labang sakatuuday pitiyang muliyaw panukas 4 emang tu ku tademaw.

"Swang-lung-hay" atu "Lu-wi-hay" mahamin tu malikid, "Law-hu-hay" atu "Lu-wi-hay" pihaceng ku kapeci' a lilis nu apilis, "Si-niw-hay" nuayawanay kilangay langat a zazan atu "aazihan tu nipahabayan a kilang" uyza silangatay ku liwliw a zazan mapeci' tu. namaninel, 2017 a mihca 8 a bulad 9 a demiad malingatu, Ciw-cay-kow aazihan pacena' maedeb, pasatezepe miawza tu midangay a labang. Se-cwan kuwan A-pa-cang-cu cyang-cu ce-ce-cow wiy-su-ci ci Liw-cuw-min hinisa Ciw-cay-kow aaziihan apasasizumaen, pasagatuen haymaw a pahulak, amisumad tu acanu a paya nu panan. Ciw-cay-kow zikuz nu ninel I 2018 a nihca 3 a bulad 8 a demiad pacema' miwawah, demidemiad mitiyang tu micumuday a tademaw cacay a demiad 2000 ku tademaw, miawza tu masakaputay a labang dada', pacena' caay piawza tu sakaku sanay midang a labang, zikuz muliyaw aca maedeb. laed tu pinaay tu a mihcaan aninelan, duduc Ciw-cay-kow nu miliwkuay a sakapu bu-cung-cin-li ci Lyaw-cin a pisiwkay "zuma aadihan paliayaw tu 2019 a mihcaan nu kalimulakay nu kanatal a lisin pahekal tu hekalay". 2019 a mihcaan 9 a bulad 24 a demiad, Se-cwan kuwan misulul ku situngusa tu cenbu, Ciw-cay-kow aazihan pasazumaen ku zuma i 9 a bulad 27 a demiad demiad nu miliwkuay nu kitakit panukas pahelak. 2019 a mihcaan 9 a bulad 27 a demiad, Ciw-cay-kow aazihan muliyaw pahelak tu aazihan, mitiyang tu kakitizaan, mitiyang tu ngatu "paydemiad 8 : 30 katukuh 17 : 00" pahekal, cacay a demiad 5000 ku pitiyang tu katuud a labang, mikawaw i wangle micakay tu paya tucek pahelak tu masakaputay, katukuh 11 a bulad 28 a demiad malingatu mipahelak tu sakakuay nu miida a labang, pahelak tu aazihan a kitizaan cacay a demiad tu piawza tu labang sakatuuday a pitiyang makay 8000 ku tademaw pacakat kkatukuh 2 emang tu tademaw. imahini Ciw-cay-kow paya nu panan aazihan, paya nu kazizeng hami i wangle pangangan mipaliayaw micakay, caay tu patizeng tu picakayan a sasingalan. 2021 a mihca 9 a bulad 28 a demiad, Ciw-cay-kow aazihan hamin nu kakitizaan panukas a pahelakan, cacay a demiaad miawza tu labang sakatuuday pitiyang muliyaw panukas 4 emang tu ku tademaw.
